hierarchy.evidence: The drawing and large product name identify the bowl at a glance, and the $46 price sits beside the prominent Add to bag button at both widths.

spacing.evidence: The desktop gutter clearly separates the drawing from the product details, while roughly 150 pixels of empty space separate shipping from the purchase bar on mobile.

typography.evidence: The serif title gives “Bowl” its own italic line on desktop and fits the full name on one mobile line, with bold “5 days” easy to pick out below the maker credit.

color.evidence: Oat and clay tones connect the page to the speckled glaze, and the plum fill singles out Add to bag at both widths.

accessibility.evidence: At both widths the visible count and purchase label correspond to “Bag, 0 items” and “Add to bag” in the browser tree, which also names the drawing and exposes an empty status region.

fidelity.evidence: Kiln & Field shows the drawn Oat Glaze Bowl, $46 price, five-day shipping, Milwaukee maker credit and Add to bag action, while confirmation after adding one bowl remains unverified.

hierarchy.evidence: At both widths the drawing and title establish the product, the price follows directly beneath the name, and a column-wide Add to bag button finishes the purchase details.

spacing.evidence: A generous gutter separates the desktop columns, and on mobile the caption sits close to the drawing while the product name, price, shipping row and button share a left edge.

typography.evidence: The two-line desktop title fits on one line on mobile, and the smaller serif price remains distinct from the readable sans-serif maker and shipping text.

color.evidence: The moss-green field brings out the bowl’s pale glaze and throwing rings, and the dark green button gives its light purchase label clear contrast against the cream page.

accessibility.evidence: Both browser trees name the drawing and Add to bag button and expose the visible zero count as “Bag, empty,” the only bag status evidenced at either width.

fidelity.evidence: Kiln & Field presents the illustrated Oat Glaze Bowl at $46 with five-day shipping and the Milwaukee throwing and glazing credit, and the supplied views show Add to bag only in the initial empty-bag state.
